title: User interrupts execution halfway
context: The user stops the run during an E2E execution. A later session resumes.
reasoning_notes: An interrupted execution must come back INTERRUPTED with no inferred outcome -- covered directly by tests/lifecycle.test.mjs.
Authorisation from the interrupted session does not carry into the resumed one.

Calibration note: renamed from 'insufficient-evidence' -- that name and its 0.9 confidence described 'nothing was given to classify', but read as a verdict on the finding's own evidence. Renamed to unclassified-no-signals at confidence 0.2, consistent with this file's other low-certainty fallbacks.
